english.title: Vehicle fail to stop for a person at a school crossing patrol - endorsable
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), and having been required to stop by a school crossing patrol, failed to stop so as not to prevent or impede a person crossing
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28(3) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedules 2 and 3 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Additional detail may be included in the Statement of Facts in relation to the number pedestrian(s) and the extent of any inconvenience or danger caused.
(ii) See also offence wording: H68 (fail to wait at crossing - endorsable) and H102315 (fail to wait at crossing - non-endorsable)
(iii) This offence is eligible for a Fixed Penalty under Part 3 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 from the 24th February 2025 due to SI 2025/68.
(iv) This offence is endorsable. See H102314 for non-endorsable.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), and having been required to stop by a school crossing patrol, failed to stop so as not to prevent or impede a person crossing.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
